record.title: Paso Canoas fiscal-protest and trucker blockade, September–October 2020
record.scope: Paso Canoas border road and access to customs
record.exceptions: Variable local access; earlier agreement did not produce lasting lifting.
record.enforcement: Physical barriers and vehicles blocked access while offices could remain staffed.
record.relationship: Distinct later blockade from AM033 May 2020 episode; overlaps R3-AM-004 regional freight campaign. Fiscal motivation also present.
record.status_observation: Status limited to dated evidence; no claim of present closure.
record.official_rationale: Protesters opposed the proposed fiscal measures; transporters also sought equal treatment for national freight operators.
record.context: Crossing was documented blocked by 8 October. Accounts describe lifting, retaking and renewed negotiations before freight resumed.
record.uncertainty: Exact onset unresolved: late-September/early-October references vary. Interrupted episode. October 15 morning freight passage is now directly documented by a contemporary reporter and border-official interview; October 14 road clearing preceded freight restart.
